quality_gate: singles only: greeks_ok=false if, outside regular hours only, |spot-close|/close > 2.5% (pre-market/after-hours repricing), or the median |call IV - put IV| over every strike within +-5% of spot having both legs with IV, across all non-expired expiries, exceeds 15 pts. source: Massive options + stocks snapshots (15-min delayed plan); SqueezeMetrics DIX.csv
convention: Dealer side ASSUMED: dealers long calls, short puts (SqueezeMetrics convention). Calls +, puts −. OI updates once a day.
